entry.title: Slicing Chrome's Zucchini Patches in Half
entry.summary: Chrome's Linux executable is 291 MB. Zucchini, the differ inside Chrome's own updater, produces a 5.9 MB patch between two adjacent stable releases; predicting the new binary instead of diffing it gets the same pair to 2.6 MB, byte-for-byte exact.
